cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(crengine-wasm C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)

# Root of CREngine source - can be overridden via -DCR_ROOT=...
if(NOT DEFINED CR_ROOT)
    set(CR_ROOT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
endif()
set(CR_SRC  ${CR_ROOT}/crengine/src)
set(CR_INC  ${CR_ROOT}/crengine/include)

# ── zlib ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set(ZLIB_DIR ${CR_ROOT}/thirdparty/zlib)
add_library(zlib STATIC
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/adler32.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/compress.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/crc32.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/deflate.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/gzio.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/infback.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/inffast.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/inflate.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/inftrees.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/trees.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/uncompr.c
    ${ZLIB_DIR}/zutil.c
)
target_include_directories(zlib PUBLIC ${ZLIB_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(zlib PRIVATE CR3_PATCH=1)

# ── FreeType 2 (using amalgamation files, same as upstream CMakeLists) ──
set(FT_DIR ${CR_ROOT}/thirdparty/freetype)
add_library(freetype STATIC
    ${FT_DIR}/src/autofit/autofit.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/bdf/bdf.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/cff/cff.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftbase.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftbbox.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftbdf.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftbitmap.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftgasp.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/cache/ftcache.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftglyph.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftgxval.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/gzip/ftgzip.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftinit.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/lzw/ftlzw.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftmm.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftotval.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftpfr.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftstroke.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftsynth.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftsystem.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/fttype1.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftwinfnt.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/base/ftxf86.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/pcf/pcf.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/pfr/pfr.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/psaux/psaux.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/pshinter/pshinter.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/psnames/psmodule.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/raster/raster.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/sfnt/sfnt.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/smooth/smooth.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/truetype/truetype.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/type1/type1.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/cid/type1cid.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/type42/type42.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/bzip2/ftbzip2.c
    ${FT_DIR}/src/winfonts/winfnt.c
)
target_include_directories(freetype PUBLIC
    ${FT_DIR}/include
    ${FT_DIR}/include/freetype
)
target_compile_definitions(freetype PRIVATE
    FT2_BUILD_LIBRARY
)

# ── libpng ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set(PNG_DIR ${CR_ROOT}/thirdparty/libpng)
configure_file(${PNG_DIR}/scripts/pnglibconf.h.prebuilt
               ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/pnglibconf.h COPYONLY)
add_library(png STATIC
    ${PNG_DIR}/png.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngerror.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngget.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngmem.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngpread.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngread.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngrio.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngrtran.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngrutil.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngset.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngtrans.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngwio.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngwrite.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngwtran.c
    ${PNG_DIR}/pngwutil.c
)
target_include_directories(png PUBLIC ${PNG_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(png PRIVATE CR3_PATCH=1)
target_link_libraries(png PUBLIC zlib)

# ── libjpeg ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set(JPEG_DIR ${CR_ROOT}/thirdparty/libjpeg)
add_library(jpeg STATIC
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jcapimin.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jchuff.c    ${JPEG_DIR}/jcomapi.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jctrans.c   ${JPEG_DIR}/jdcoefct.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jdmainct.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jdpostct.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jfdctfst.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jidctred.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jutils.c    ${JPEG_DIR}/jcapistd.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jcinit.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jcparam.c   ${JPEG_DIR}/jdapimin.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jdcolor.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jdmarker.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jdsample.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jfdctint.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jmemmgr.c   ${JPEG_DIR}/jccoefct.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jcmainct.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jcphuff.c   ${JPEG_DIR}/jdapistd.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jddctmgr.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jdmaster.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jdtrans.c   ${JPEG_DIR}/jidctflt.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jmemnobs.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jccolor.c   ${JPEG_DIR}/jcmarker.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jcprepct.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jdatadst.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jdhuff.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jdmerge.c   ${JPEG_DIR}/jerror.c    ${JPEG_DIR}/jidctfst.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jquant1.c   ${JPEG_DIR}/jcdctmgr.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jcmaster.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jcsample.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jdatasrc.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jdinput.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jdphuff.c   ${JPEG_DIR}/jfdctflt.c  ${JPEG_DIR}/jidctint.c
    ${JPEG_DIR}/jquant2.c
)
target_include_directories(jpeg PUBLIC ${JPEG_DIR})

# ── CREngine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set(CRENGINE_SOURCES
    ${CR_SRC}/cp_stats.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvstring.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/props.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lstridmap.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/rtfimp.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/cri18n.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvmemman.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvstyles.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/crtxtenc.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvtinydom.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvstream.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvxml.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvstsheet.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/txtselector.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/crtest.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvbmpbuf.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvfnt.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/hyphman.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvfntman.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvimg.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvdrawbuf.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvdocview.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvpagesplitter.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvtextfm.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvrend.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/wolutil.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/hist.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/epubfmt.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/pdbfmt.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/bookformats.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/docxfmt.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/fb3fmt.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/mdfmt.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/odtfmt.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/odxutil.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/mathml.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/textlang.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/s32utils.cpp
    ${CR_SRC}/lvopc.cpp
    ${CR_ROOT}/crengine/qimagescale/qimagescale.cpp
)

add_library(crengine STATIC ${CRENGINE_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(crengine PUBLIC
    ${CR_INC}
    ${CR_ROOT}/crengine/qimagescale
    ${FT_DIR}/include
    ${ZLIB_DIR}
)
target_include_directories(crengine PUBLIC
    ${PNG_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    ${JPEG_DIR}
)
target_compile_definitions(crengine PRIVATE
    LINUX=1
    _LINUX=1
    USE_FREETYPE=1
    USE_ZLIB=1
    USE_LIBPNG=1
    USE_LIBJPEG=1
    LDOM_USE_OWN_MEM_MAN=0
    COLOR_BACKBUFFER=0
    USE_DOM_UTF8_STORAGE=1
    CR3_PATCH=1
)
target_link_libraries(crengine PUBLIC freetype zlib png jpeg)

# ── WASM binding (final executable) ────────────────────────────────────
add_executable(crengine_wasm ${CR_ROOT}/wasm_binding.cpp ${CR_ROOT}/wasm_stubs.cpp)
target_include_directories(crengine_wasm PRIVATE ${CR_INC} ${FT_DIR}/include ${ZLIB_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(crengine_wasm PRIVATE
    LINUX=1
    _LINUX=1
    USE_FREETYPE=1
    USE_ZLIB=1
    USE_LIBPNG=1
    USE_LIBJPEG=1
    LDOM_USE_OWN_MEM_MAN=0
    COLOR_BACKBUFFER=0
    USE_DOM_UTF8_STORAGE=1
)
target_link_libraries(crengine_wasm PRIVATE crengine freetype zlib png jpeg)

set_target_properties(crengine_wasm PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "crengine"
    SUFFIX ".js"
)

# Emscripten link flags
target_link_options(crengine_wasm PRIVATE
    "SHELL:-s MODULARIZE=1"
    "SHELL:-s EXPORT_NAME='CREngine'"
    "SHELL:-s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1"
    "SHELL:-s INITIAL_MEMORY=67108864"
    "SHELL:-s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=2147483648"
    "SHELL:-s FORCE_FILESYSTEM=1"
    "SHELL:-s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=['FS','HEAPU8']"
    "SHELL:--bind"
    "SHELL:-s WASM=1"
    "SHELL:-s ENVIRONMENT='web'"
    "SHELL:-s EXPORT_ES6=0"
    "SHELL:-s NO_EXIT_RUNTIME=1"
    "SHELL:-s ASSERTIONS=1"
    "SHELL:-s ALLOW_TABLE_GROWTH=1"
    "SHELL:-s EMULATE_FUNCTION_POINTER_CASTS=1"
    -O2
)
